notes.title: Clarity, Eye Comfort, Wisps Update [#8]
notes.content: [h2]Clarity & Eye Comfort[/h2][list][*][p]The background was greatly muted, you can intensify it back in the Video settings now[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy and ally visuals were greatly boosted to stand out[/p][/*][*][p]All enemies now have a rose-red bloody boundary[/p][/*][*][p]All allies now have a green boundary[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy spawn visuals greatly softened not to be too distracting[/p][/*][*][p]Attack visuals (Wisps, Blasts and Rifts) slightly muted not to overpower foreground[/p][/*][*][p]Wisp and Hex VFX altered to blend better[/p][/*][*][p][b]New on Damaged VFX[/b] to clearly indicate when the player gets damaged![/p][/*][*][p]Some background colors altered to be less distracting[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Store graphics have already been updated this time![/i][/p][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Enemies now always spawn with a Control Resistance Color[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wisps now wander around[/b] randomly[/p][/*][*][p]Wisps are now stronger pulled by Rifts[/p][/*][*][p]Wisps no longer hit enemies instantly in range like lightning, but instead quickly fly towards them like missiles[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: New on Damaged VFX to clearly indicate when the player gets damaged!
Wisps now wander around randomly

notes.title: New Frosty Mechanic: Antihex, Variety, QoL, Graphics (again), VFX Update [#7]
notes.content: [h2]Main Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Antihex[/b]: a new crystalline debuff applied by Blasts and Rifts that slows down enemies and is shattered on Wall Hits [i]because some players felt like the game became way too fast due to Hex being the only debuff[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Superpowers remixed[/b] to add a lot of options related to Antihex, some for conversion between Hex and Antihex, most to make Hex superpowers also apply to Antihex[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hex[/b] greatly buffed to account for its opposite existing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy spawning VFX!!![/b] are finally here, helping you see clearly where the enemies are going to appear[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics upgrades[/b] to help with the 3D feeling and clarity, including enemy glow, etc, WITHOUT making performance worse[/p][/*][*][p][b]Contrast clarity[/b] improved, the background muted, important objects are more visible [/p][/*][*][p][b]Color changes from superpowers[/b] to indicate their effects better[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Store graphics will be updated accordingly... as usual... there graphics updates might become a pattern...[/i][/p]

tags.feature: Antihex: a new crystalline debuff applied by Blasts and Rifts that slows down enemies and is shattered on Wall Hits because some players felt like the game became way too fast due to Hex being the only debuff
Superpowers remixed to add a lot of options related to Antihex, some for conversion between Hex and Antihex, most to make Hex superpowers also apply to Antihex

tags.balance_change: Hex greatly buffed to account for its opposite existing

tags.feature: Enemy spawning VFX!!! are finally here, helping you see clearly where the enemies are going to appear
Graphics upgrades to help with the 3D feeling and clarity, including enemy glow, etc, WITHOUT making performance worse
Contrast clarity improved, the background muted, important objects are more visible
Color changes from superpowers to indicate their effects better

notes.title: Biomes, Variety, Mechanics, Font, Graphics Update [#6]
notes.content: [h2]Main Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]2 extra biomes[/b]: in addition to the normal biome, 2 new wild biomes now can be unlocked as you progress in the game:[/p][olist][*][p]A default biome[/p][/*][*][p]An energetic biome with accelerated enemy spawns, push-pull (on enemies) and pulsating dish size[/p][/*][*][p]A decaying biome with more spirit enemies, slowed down enemy spawns, pull (on enemies) and slowly shrinking dish size[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]3 new superpowers[/b] related to Pebbles[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ward[/b], [b]Dash[/b] and [b]Regen[/b] mechanics rebalanced with many tweaks and interdependencies (more in the Info menu)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spirit Enemies[/b] now deal less damage, cut down Energy and can be slightly damaged[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wisp Hits[/b] and [b]Hex[/b] now have more chaotic movement effects[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded graphics towards physics-based 3D with volumetric shadowing and water distortions[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded the font engine to handle kerning and advance, introduced a beautiful font that fits the game better[/p][/*][*][p]Visual tweaks[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Store graphics will be updated accordingly[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Upcoming[/i][/h3][p][i]New Antihex slowdown-shatter-type (eldritch ice) debuff on enemies to enable more interactions with Blasts, Rifts and Wall Hits.[/i][/p]

tags.feature: 2 extra biomes: in addition to the normal biome, 2 new wild biomes now can be unlocked as you progress in the game:
3 new superpowers related to Pebbles

notes.title: Knockable Pebble Disks, Variety, Graphics Update [#5] + Full Release in 12h
notes.content: [h2]Main Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added[/b] [b]Pebbles[/b]: physical disks that can be knocked into enemies for similar effects as wall hits, bounce off walls and can be used as shields[/p][/*][*][p][b]New enemy subtype[/b]: Spirit - can't be damaged, but dies on its own[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 new superpowers[/b] related to Pebbles[/p][/*][*][p][b]New mutation group[/b]: Rift Armor, this time very risky health-draining mutations to challenge you![/p][/*][*][p]Replaced placeholder toon graphics with more PBR but still stylized graphics [i]store graphics will be updated ASAP[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced enemy speeds to be more manageable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the client in high-ping online co-op being flung around when using mouse-only movement control[/p][/*][/list][h2]Full Release[/h2][p]The core mechanics are all implemented, the online co-op works so far as the numerous tests go, full release is ready. [b]The following updates will focus on content, variety, QoL and bugfixes[/b]. While the price might increase at some point after a lot of new content is added, it won't increase at the moment of full release in 12 hours.[/p]

notes.title: Online Co-op now available! Multiplayer Update [#4] + Upcoming Full Release
notes.content: [h2]Duo online co-op now available[/h2][list][*][p]One player hosts the game, another joins through the Steam Friend List[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Datagram Relay is used, there is no need to forward ports, host and client IP addresses are hidden[/p][/*][*][p]The host can autosave the game progress on every completed level[/p][/*][*][p]There is currently only one save for solo runs and only one save for co-op runs (belonging to the host, any client can join any co-op save)[/p][/*][*][p]The host and the client have their own superpowers, some superpowers have global effects[/p][/*][*][p]The host and the client have their own mutations, in case of different mutations the effect is chosen based on which player is closer to the event[/p][/*][/list][h3]Requirements for Host[/h3][p]300KB/s upload speed, 100KB/s download speed, minimum 1280MTU, <20% UDP packet loss, minimum 200/200 packets per second up/down[/p][h3]Requirements for Client[/h3][p]100KB/s upload speed, 300KB/s download speed, minimum 1280MTU, <20% UDP packet loss, minimum 200/200 packets per second up/down[/p][p][/p][h3]Additional changes[/h3][list][*][p]Simulation and netcode tickrate increased to 200hz[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly reduced input latencies[/p][/*][*][p]Netcode extrapolation in case of dropped UDP packets[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced kinetics and speeds of entities[/p][/*][*][p]A lot of QoL related to Steam overlay and Rich Presence[/p][/*][/list][h2]Upcoming Full Release Update Plan[/h2][p]As the core features are almost fully polished now, the Full Release will happen after Update #5 somewhere next week. Afterwards the updates will be content updates (new biomes, environmental interactions), variety updates (more behaviors, superpowers, etc.) and QoL updates[/p]

tags.feature: Duo online co-op now available
One player hosts the game, another joins through the Steam Friend List
Steam Datagram Relay is used, there is no need to forward ports, host and client IP addresses are hidden
The host can autosave the game progress on every completed level
There is currently only one save for solo runs and only one save for co-op runs (belonging to the host, any client can join any co-op save)
The host and the client have their own superpowers, some superpowers have global effects
The host and the client have their own mutations, in case of different mutations the effect is chosen based on which player is closer to the event

tags.balance_change: Simulation and netcode tickrate increased to 200hz

tags.feature: Netcode extrapolation in case of dropped UDP packets

tags.balance_change: Rebalanced kinetics and speeds of entities

tags.feature: A lot of QoL related to Steam overlay and Rich Presence

notes.title: Controller Support, QoL, Readability Update [#1]
notes.content:
Starting from now you can play the game in any of the following configurations:
[list]
[*]Mouse only (as recommended)
[*]Keyboard only
[*]Controller only
[*]Any combination of 1 mouse, 1 keyboard and 16 controllers
[/list]
All menus can be navigated with any combination of these now. The game will automatically pause if you disconnect or connect controllers. The switching between devices is implemented to not require any settings adjustments and happens automatically.

The SteamInput API has very simple controls for controllers:
[list]
[*][b]DPad[/b] movement and menu navigation
[*][b]Left analog stick[/b] movement and menu navigation
[*][b]3 buttons (Cross|A/Circle|B/Options|Start)[/b] dash/back/pause ingame and select/back/unpause in menu
[/list]

Additional changes:
[list]
[*]Text VFX scaling fixed to be readable in small windows
[*]Improved readability of button and card states
[*]Adjusted several superpower descriptions (related to "weaken" being unclear)
[*]Expanded the info menu with clearer descriptions and also tips
[*]Added early game maximum level ramp (3, 6, 9, 10, 10, 10... instead of always 10, 10, 10...) to enable early accessible mutations
[*]Fixed achievements not showing up without game restart
[*]Preparations for Steam Deck support
[/list]
